outputs.explanation: Body weight, LW/BW, and FW/BW are shown as scatter/dot plots with individual mouse data points plus mean±SD overlaid.
Panel B is a photograph of gross mouse anatomy, not a plot.
Panel C consists of micrograph images (H&E and Oil Red O staining), not a plot.
Panel D is a dot blot/methylene blue staining image (blot), not a plot.
The bar chart of 5mC/Methylene Blue ratio shows individual data points (dots) for each NC and HFD sample overlaid on the bars.
The bottom bar chart quantifying TET1/TET2/TET3 over GAPDH shows individual data points overlaid on the bars, in addition to the western blot images above.
